purpose: 28 complete original NativeZipper executions of the 28-tape source-and-image caller. Nine maps at N=1,2 and every row, plus a quarter-cell equality case at N=4. Includes identity, doubling, fractional, negative numerator/denominator coefficients, negative endpoints, outside domains and empty source intersections. Direct rational max(lo,i/N)<min(hi,(i+1)/N) supplies the Boolean oracle; original leftPair/rightPair supply source fractions. Independent natural component arithmetic supplies all eight image outputs. Check all six source outputs, eight image outputs, source grid/four products, three final form products, dimension/index/unit/zero/fuel, markers, blank scratch, halt and all28 unequal absolute head positions. All22 work/output tapes initially blank. Seed/input resources are supplied. Five source-work erasures and nine image-product erasures are included in the full execution. Final work remains stored; dimension scaling, raw-input loading, seed integration and row-to-row cleanup are not claimed.

import TransposeFollowup.SourceImagesRun
open TransposeFollowup
def identityMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def doubleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 2
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1 / 2
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def fractionalMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 1
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def shiftMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := -1; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def poleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := -2; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def coefficientMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1 / 2; b := 1 / 3; c := 1 / 5; d := 1; lo := -1 / 2; hi := 3 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def outsideMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 2; hi := 3
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def cases : List RationalMobius :=
  [identityMap, doubleMap, fractionalMap, shiftMap, poleMap, coefficientMap, outsideMap]


def negativeMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := -2; hi := -1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def zeroHiMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := -1; hi := 0
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def negativeCoefficients : RationalMobius where
  a := -1; b := -2; c := 1; d := -3; lo := 4; hi := 5
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

open FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine
open SourceImages

def bits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map n.testBit

def sourceIndex : SourceEndpoints.Port → Nat
  | .shared .dimension => 0 | .shared .index => 1 | .shared .unit => 2
  | .shared .zero => 3 | .shared .fuel => 4 | .shared .scratch => 5 | .shared .grid => 6
  | .shared (.work j) => 7+j.val | .shared (.out j) => 11+j.val | .other j => 14+j.val

def portIndex : Port → Nat
  | .source p => sourceIndex p | .work j => 17+j.val | .out j b => 20+2*j.val+(if b then 1 else 0)

def sourcePorts : List SourceEndpoints.Port :=
  ([EndpointClip.Port.dimension,.index,.unit,.zero,.fuel,.scratch,.grid] ++
    (List.finRange 4).map EndpointClip.Port.work ++ (List.finRange 3).map EndpointClip.Port.out).map
      SourceEndpoints.Port.shared ++ (List.finRange 3).map SourceEndpoints.Port.other

def ports : List Port := sourcePorts.map Port.source ++ (List.finRange 3).map Port.work ++
  (List.finRange 4).flatMap (fun j => [Port.out j false,Port.out j true])
def heads (p : Port) : Int := 29*(portIndex p : Int)-313

def componentsOracle (u v : Int) (p : Int × Int) : Nat × Nat :=
  (u.natAbs*(if u<0 then (-p.1).toNat else p.1.toNat)+(if v<0 then 0 else v.natAbs*p.2.toNat),
   u.natAbs*(if u<0 then p.1.toNat else (-p.1).toNat)+(if v<0 then v.natAbs*p.2.toNat else 0))

def checkRow (F : RationalMobius) (N : Nat) (i : Fin N) : Bool :=
  let n := PaddedWord.word (PaddedWord.commonConstant F) id (bits N.size N)
  let m := n.length
  let iw := bits m i.val
  let sourcePair (upper : Bool) := if upper then F.rightPair i else F.leftPair i
  let triple (upper : Bool) : Fin 3 → Nat :=
    ![(sourcePair upper).1.toNat,(-(sourcePair upper).1).toNat,(sourcePair upper).2.toNat]
  let imageExpected (j : Fin 4) :=
    let p := sourcePair (decide (2≤j.val))
    if j.val%2=1 then componentsOracle F.integralC F.integralD p
    else componentsOracle F.integralA F.integralB p
  let saved := decide (max F.lo ((i.val : Rat)/N) < min F.hi (((i.val : Rat)+1)/N))
  let A := F.hi.num.natAbs
  let B := F.hi.den
  let sourceWork : Fin 4 → Nat := ![A%2^m,B%2^m,(A*N+(if F.hi.num<0 then 0 else B))%2^m,(B*(i.val+1))%2^m]
  let lastProducts : Fin 3 → Nat := ![F.integralC.natAbs*triple true 0%2^m,
    F.integralC.natAbs*triple true 1%2^m,F.integralD.natAbs*triple true 2%2^m]
  let S := F.lo.num.natAbs+F.lo.den+F.hi.num.natAbs+F.hi.den
  let K := 2*F.integralA.natAbs+F.integralB.natAbs+2*F.integralC.natAbs+F.integralD.natAbs
  let c := NativeZipper.run (program F) (436*m+1105+2*(S+K)*(18*m+52))
    (zipperCfg (.source (.lower (.inl (.grid (.init (.erase 0)))))) (initial n iw) heads)
  decide (c.core.pc=.done saved) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.source (.shared .dimension))=Counter.marked n) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.source (.shared .index))=Counter.marked iw) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.source (.shared .unit))=Counter.marked (true::List.replicate (m-1) false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.source (.shared .zero))=Counter.marked (List.replicate m false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.source (.shared .fuel))=Counter.marked [true]) &&
    decide ((c.core.tapes (.source (.shared .scratch))).left=[.start]) &&
    (c.core.tapes (.source (.shared .scratch))).right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.source (.shared .grid))=Counter.marked (bits m (i.val+1))) &&
    (List.finRange 4).all (fun j => decide (c.core.tapes (.source (.shared (.work j)))=Counter.marked (bits m (sourceWork j)))) &&
    [false,true].all (fun upper => (List.finRange 3).all (fun j =>
      decide (c.core.tapes (.source (if upper then .other j else .shared (.out j)))=Counter.marked (bits m (triple upper j))))) &&
    (List.finRange 3).all (fun j => decide (c.core.tapes (.work j)=Counter.marked (bits m (lastProducts j)))) &&
    (List.finRange 4).all (fun j =>
      decide (c.core.tapes (.out j false)=Counter.marked (bits m (imageExpected j).1)) &&
      decide (c.core.tapes (.out j true)=Counter.marked (bits m (imageExpected j).2))) &&
    ports.all (fun p => decide (c.pos p=heads p))

def checks : Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut count := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for F in [identityMap,doubleMap,fractionalMap,shiftMap,poleMap,outsideMap,negativeMap,zeroHiMap,negativeCoefficients] do
    for N in [1,2] do
      for i in List.finRange N do
        count := count+1
        if !checkRow F N i then failures := failures+1
  count := count+1
  if !checkRow poleMap 4 1 then failures := failures+1
  return (count,failures)
#eval checks

def portFin (p : Port) : Fin 28 := ⟨portIndex p,by
  cases p with
  | source q => cases q with
    | shared r => cases r <;> simp [portIndex,sourceIndex] <;> omega
    | other j => simp [portIndex,sourceIndex]; omega
  | work j => simp [portIndex]; omega
  | out j b => cases b <;> simp [portIndex] <;> omega⟩

def portAt : Fin 28 → Port := ![.source (.shared .dimension),.source (.shared .index),.source (.shared .unit),.source (.shared .zero),.source (.shared .fuel),.source (.shared .scratch),.source (.shared .grid),.source (.shared (.work 0)),.source (.shared (.work 1)),.source (.shared (.work 2)),.source (.shared (.work 3)),.source (.shared (.out 0)),.source (.shared (.out 1)),.source (.shared (.out 2)),.source (.other 0),.source (.other 1),.source (.other 2),.work 0,.work 1,.work 2,.out 0 false,.out 0 true,.out 1 false,.out 1 true,.out 2 false,.out 2 true,.out 3 false,.out 3 true]

theorem portAt_portFin (p : Port) : portAt (portFin p)=p := by

    | other j => fin_cases j <;> rfl
